summary: Fact caching is always on, but only one fact cache plugin is active. Select it with ANSIBLE_CACHE_PLUGIN or fact_caching in ansible.cfg, using the FQCN for collection plugins. Playbooks should never depend on a cache hit or the cache existing.
questions: How do I switch fact caching to jsonfile?
How do I configure redis as the fact cache in ansible.cfg?
How do I reference a fact cache plugin from a collection?
Should my playbook fail if a cached fact is missing?
Can I have two fact cache plugins active at once?

answer_card.title: Selecting the fact cache plugin
answer_card.answer_md:
Only one fact cache plugin is active at a time. Set it by environment variable:

```shell
export ANSIBLE_CACHE_PLUGIN=jsonfile
```

or in `ansible.cfg`:

```ini
[defaults]
fact_caching=redis
```

For a collection plugin use the FQCN: `fact_caching = namespace.collection_name.cache_plugin_name`. Configure each plugin's own settings as well.

Don't write playbooks that fail on a cache miss or a missing cache.
